verdict.rationale: Amplitude's HTTP V2 endpoint and general event-ingestion APIs (amplitude-docs-2, amplitude-docs-12) suggest a path for sending historical or exported event data into the platform, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk/batch import tool, a migration path from other analytics tools, or CSV/file-based import for historical backfill. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch import API or tool, explicit historical backfill guidance, and any mention of importing from competitor platforms (e.g. Mixpanel/GA data migration).
